name: Kasai Kyouko
source:
Hobbies: Killing time at the warehouse behind the gymnasium
Likes: Vampire [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Novel]I-Novels[/url]
Dislikes: Meaningless lessons
A student at St. Julian Girls' Academy, she is the leader of a delinquent group.
A returnee, she has been accustomed to the dry Western-style human relationships since she was young, so she has a natural aversion to the humid Japanese human relationships.
She has an extremely earnest personality and excellent grades, but for some reason she often escapes classes to read books in the storeroom behind the gym.
